no-restricted-syntax.message: This page renders on the server at the request's moment and hydrates in the reader's browser later, so it may not read the clock here: a render that does fails hydration (React #418/#423/#425) once the two clocks disagree. Take the request's `now` prop (contentPageClock, CLOCK_UNITS in lib/content/pageClock.ts) and useReaderClock(now) after mount (lib/time/readerClock.ts).

This page renders on the server at the request's moment and hydrates in the reader's browser later, so it may not read the clock here: a render that does fails hydration (React #418/#423/#425) once the two clocks disagree. Take the request's `now` prop (contentPageClock, CLOCK_UNITS in lib/content/pageClock.ts) and useReaderClock(now) after mount (lib/time/readerClock.ts).
Called with no argument this reads the clock; pass the moment explicitly (e.g. serverWeekday(new Date(clock)) with clock from useReaderClock).
